Students pursuing Bachelor’s or Master’s degrees

The Singapore International Pre-Graduate Award (SIPGA) 2025 is an initiative by the Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A-STAR) for students pursuing Bachelor’s or Master’s degrees. This award aims to support short-term research attachments for top international students at A*STAR, giving them the unique opportunity to experience the vibrant scientific environment in A*STAR Research Institutes and Consortia, and work with distinguished and world-renowned researchers. The selected students will receive a monthly stipend of S$2,000 (approx. ₹1,71,675).
The Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) is Singapore's lead government agency dedicated to fostering world-class scientific research and talent for a vibrant knowledge-based economy.
To be eligible, an applicant must:
be an international undergraduate degree student enrolled in the third or fourth year, OR
have achieved/on track to achieve at least a Second-Class (Upper) Honours or equivalent for a bachelor’s degree
be proficient in the English language (written and spoken)
remain matriculated in their home university during the attachment period

The above eligibility criteria are not exhaustive. A*STAR may include additional selection criteria based on prevailing scholarship policies. These policies can be amended from time to time without notice.
The selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of S$2,000 (approx. ₹1,71,675).
SIPGA awardees must complete an online SIPGA Attachment Report by the end of the attachment.
